title: The founding
text:
Mieppi, Leofgifu, Beornhild, Halldis Sigurdardóttir, Helmikki, Leofweard, Aodhín, Áilu, Mieppi and Tautmantė were among the founding party in Winter 800.

Mieppi and Leofweard worked as fishers. Leofgifu, Helmikki, Aodhín, Mieppi and Tautmantė worked as hunters. Beornhild, Halldis Sigurdardóttir and Áilu worked as farmers.

The founding party had two adult cows and one adult bull and 1 longship.

Mieppi and Halldis Sigurdardóttir were already partners. Leofgifu and Mieppi were already partners. Leofweard and Aodhín were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.
